# Stack Abuse

> > Stack Abuse is a developer resource platform offering practical tools for code conversion, data transformation, and hands-on machine learning courses.

Stack Abuse provides both a comprehensive toolbox for everyday developer tasks and in-depth guided courses on machine learning, computer vision, and modern application architecture. The platform serves developers and data scientists seeking practical solutions and educational content.

## Key Topics

- Python
- Machine Learning
- TensorFlow
- Keras
- Scikit-Learn
- Computer Vision
- Data Conversion
- Code Converters
- Large Language Models
- Developer Tools
- SVMs
- DeepDream
- Federated Learning
- Graph RAG
- CI/CD Testing

## Developer Toolbox

- [Developer Toolbox - Stack Abuse](https://stackabuse.com/tools): Main toolbox page featuring Base64, CSV, JSON, XML converters and utilities

## Machine Learning & Computer Vision Courses

- [Bank Note Fraud Detection with SVMs in Python with Scikit-Learn](https://stackabuse.com/courses/bank-note-fraud-detection-with-svms-in-python-with-scikit-learn): Guided project on SVM-based fraud detection using Python and Scikit-Learn
- [DeepDream with Keras and Tensorflow - Neural Networks That Hallucinate?](https://stackabuse.com/courses/deepdream-with-keras-and-tensorflow-neural-networks-that-hallucinate): Tutorial on DeepDream algorithm using Keras and TensorFlow for image generation
- [DeepLabV3+ Semantic Segmentation with Keras](https://stackabuse.com/courses/deeplabv3-semantic-segmentation-with-keras): Guided project on semantic segmentation with DeepLabV3+ and Keras

## Advanced AI & Modern Development

- [Graph RAG: Elevating AI with Dynamic Knowledge Graphs](https://stackabuse.com/graph-rag-elevating-ai-with-dynamic-knowledge-graphs): Advanced guide on Graph RAG and knowledge graphs for LLM enhancement
- [Federated Learning Explained: Collaborative AI Without Data Sharing](https://stackabuse.com/federated-learning-explained-collaborative-ai-without-data-sharing): Article on federated learning for privacy-preserving collaborative AI systems
- [AI-Powered Playwright: Building a Self-Healing CI/CD Testing Pipeline](https://stackabuse.com/ai-powered-playwright-building-a-self-healing-ci-cd-testing-pipeline): Guide on AI-powered test automation with Playwright and self-healing capabilities
- [Building a Developer-Friendly App Stack for 2026](https://stackabuse.com/building-a-developer-friendly-app-stack-for-2026): Article on modern app stack architecture with AWS, Kubernetes, and DevOps

## Home

- [Stack Abuse](https://stackabuse.com): Stack Abuse homepage showcasing developer tools for code conversion and productivity
